text:
sam: Hi all, I'm starting my first on-call rotation Monday and want to make sure I don't miss any setup steps. I tried the onboarding doc but a few links 404. Anyone available to run a quick sanity check this week?

lee: Welcome Sam! :tada: TL;DR checklist I use: 1) PD invite + enable mobile push 2) Slack channels: #prod-alerts, #infra-pagers, #eng-oncall 3) Okta role 'oncall' and project-level log access 4) Confirm Grafana + Stackdriver dashboards load 5) Practice alert with a buddy.

lee: If links are broken, ops-docs-bot usually has cached versions. Try: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONCALL/ or ping me. Also, make sure your mobile number is verified in PagerDuty.

anya: I can do a 20m smoke sim Tue 9am PT. We usually run two quick scenarios: a misrouted queue that causes spikes, and a degraded downstream. Plan: simulate alert, ack, triage logs, temporary mitigation, escalate if necessary, and run the comms template. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/9442.

sam: Thanks Lee and Anya. I tried to accept the PD invite but got an "invite expired". oncall-coordinator can you reissue?

oncall-coordinator: Reissued PD invite to sam just now. Check email (also search spam). If you still can't accept, reply here with the exact error and I'll escalate to security.

infra-bot: Infra: Okta request for sam created (ticket #INC-4721). Please allow 15-30m for propagation.

sam: Got the invite, accepted. Mobile push verified. I can't access the private runbooks — 403 on Confluence.

oncall-coordinator: Confluence 403 usually means not in the 'oncall' group. @infra-bot can you confirm group add?

infra-bot: User sam added to group 'oncall'. Confluence permissions updated.

anya: While we wait, skim these two: "runbook-checklist-quickstart" and "pagerduty-basic-ops". They are short and hit the key steps. I'll DM a short checklist before Tue.

lee: A few pro tips for new folks: - If you get a noisy repeat alert, check the dedup key in PD and the alerting rule timeseries. - For escalations, remember the oncall-2 is paged after 5 unacked minutes for SEV2+. - Use the incident comms template: subject line format is "[SEV] <service> — <short symptom>".

sam: Quick question: what's the recommended way to test alerts from my laptop without touching prod?

ops-docs-bot: Docs: Use the internal test endpoint documented at https://internal.redwood.ai/alerts/test. Example: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TEST_TOKEN}" -d '{"service":"my-test","severity":"critical"}' https://internal.redwood.ai/alerts/test```

lee: Also remember SSH via bastion requires MFA. If you don't have jump host access, file an infra ticket with subject "bastion access: sam".

sam: All set for Tue 9am. Thanks for the quick turnaround on invites and perms. Appreciate the pre-read links.

anya: Cool. I'll send the calendar invite and attach the mini-runbook. We'll do the sim cold for the first alert so you can experience the flow. After the sim, we'll create a short postmortem stub to practice the template.

sam: Sounds great — see you Tue. :thumbsup:
